learning_outcomes.text: Design a custom GPT with clear instructions, scope and conversation starters
Add knowledge files and configure tools or actions for a custom GPT
Test a custom GPT against representative tasks and edge cases
Govern custom GPTs with sharing controls, review and versioning

integrative_case: A firm builds an internal policy-helper custom GPT: the team writes scoped instructions and starters, curates knowledge files, decides where an action is needed, builds a test set covering edge cases, then sets sharing to internal-only with a named owner and a versioned review before each update.
